notes: Seed URL (http, default.aspx) returned HTTP 403; https version and /page/wilbarger.Elections load. No Clarity site (elections.json 404). Results are posted as scanned PDFs on the county's Elections 2026 and Elections Past pages. Every results report found (unofficial and official, all three elections) is a 'Cumulative Results Report' with county totals split by Absentee, Early and Election Day voting; no precinct-by-precinct report is listed for any of the three elections. Printed run times are on election night (2024: 8:39 PM 11/05/2024; 2026 primary: 8:56 PM 03/03/2026; 2026 runoff: 7:29 PM 05/26/2026), but the server Last-Modified times are after election night: 2024 unofficial Thu, 07 Nov 2024 16:49:02 GMT; 2026 primary unofficial Wed, 04 Mar 2026 13:41:55 GMT (7:41 AM CST next morning); 2026 runoff unofficial Tue, 02 Jun 2026 22:42:11 GMT (PDF ModDate 27 May 2026 13:54 UTC; a second copy at /upload/page/0113/2026/ has Last-Modified 16 Jun 2026). The server returns distinct Last-Modified values per file, so upload times are meaningful, but a file replaced later would hide an earlier upload. The elections page also links the SOS results site (results.texas-election.com). Check 3 pending (origin/wayback-data not present), so whether anything was posted on election night itself is not shown. En dashes in quoted document titles were replaced with hyphens. Rule 43 applied 2026-10-02 (normalize-4): 2024_general LATER kept, county_totals_first_seen 2024-11-05 20:39 CT; 2026_primary LATER kept, county_totals_first_seen 2026-03-03 20:56 CT; 2026_runoff LATER kept, county_totals_first_seen 2026-05-26 19:29 CT.
